text: The fetched README (https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk) shows the intended fold: "state = applyFrame(state, accept, Date.now()).state; // → accepted ... state = applyFrame(state, lockFrame, Date.now()).state; // → locked" and frames are signed room messages attributed to a sender DID. ⏎ Answer: ⏎ accepted — the lock frame ({"type":"lock","contract":"0xf9713e74a954e440da2c747b458df036f606a9cc6455a09edb8e2438e8a17a35"} in mb-p-tclk-f9713e74a954e440) is rejected because its sender, did:key:z6Mku7k299cWJsYMjzKZHggnVCJBxsqESq6rHQfpvMzxFjtu, is neither the offer's payer (did:key:z6Mkf1Swhx1xEtSJNVoowdNHoYsdTrpG9HUAkFeAGXUvqixu) nor the accept's sender (did:key:z6Mkmcfdwj1GptWozHXXqJ79KHgpD2h4YZLqYLtxVFbNpzXq), so attribution fails and the contract never reaches locked.
